titulo: Very busy. Then you walked in.
caption:
Very busy. Then you walked in.

I was busy with my mug. You walked three steps in and I stopped and turned to you.

Nobody asked me to. That is the whole behavior.

Send it to the friend you stop everything for.

#Cella #relatable #friendship

Closer to yourself.

More behaviors: link in bio.
descripcion:
Very busy. Then you walked in. Not busy.

Stopping what you are doing when someone walks in is a small, exact way to say "you come first".

#Cella #relatable #friendship

NAOS · by NMR
#shorts
alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A pink room with a black table on the wall and a steaming mug on it, and a plank floor. An ink-black block figure stares at the mug, swaying a little. A royal blue figure walks three steps in from the left. The black figure goes wide-eyed, turns toward it and leans in. Both end side by side with happy closed eyes. The text, which appears after the first second: me, very busy. Then: you walk in. not busy.
